content.caption: Two-panel line chart of training reward over 200 steps for PPO and GRPO on the Answer Agent, for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct. GRPO rises faster early, and both methods plateau near 0.3.
content.description: The figure has two side-by-side line plots that share a y-axis labelled 'Training Reward'. The page context says the reward is exact match on the Answer Agent. The y-axis has ticks at 0.0, 0.1, 0.2 and 0.3, and the plotted range runs from about 0 to 0.37. The x-axis has no title and shows training steps, with ticks at 0, 50, 100, 150 and 200. Each panel has a legend in the lower right: a red line is PPO and a blue line is GRPO. Both curves are noisy per-step traces. No values are printed, so all numbers below are approximate read-offs. Panel (a), Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct: GRPO (blue) starts near 0.05 and jumps within the first ~10 steps to about 0.25. It hovers around 0.27–0.3 until step ~50, then briefly dips to roughly 0.15–0.2 just after step 50. It recovers to about 0.3 by step ~60, fluctuates between about 0.27 and 0.33 afterwards, and ends near 0.32. PPO (red) starts near 0.03 and climbs gradually: about 0.1 around step 15, about 0.2 at step 50, and about 0.3 by step ~70. It then overlaps GRPO at 0.28–0.33 and drifts slightly higher late in training, peaking near 0.36–0.37 around steps 180–195. It ends around 0.34, slightly above GRPO. Panel (b), Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct: GRPO (blue) starts near 0.05, shoots up to about 0.2–0.25 within the first ~10 steps and about 0.27 by step ~15. It then stays roughly flat with noise between about 0.25 and 0.31 through step 200, ending near 0.3. PPO (red) stays near 0.02–0.07 for the first ~20 steps, then rises steeply to about 0.2 around steps 25–30. After that it climbs more slowly, to about 0.23 at step 50 and about 0.27 at step 100. It merges with GRPO at about 0.28–0.30 from roughly step 125–150 onward and ends near 0.29. Overall, GRPO converges much faster early on for both models. The gap is most visible on Qwen, where PPO lags for about 20 steps. PPO catches up later, and both methods reach similar final rewards of about 0.3, with PPO slightly higher at the end on Llama.
